title: Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Project Manager – Civil, MEP & Interior Fit-Outs

**Experience:** 8–10 Years

**Reporting To:** Director

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Function:** Project Management & Site Execution

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in civil construction, complemented by strong execution knowledge across MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) services and commercial/corporate interior fit-outs. **Reporting directly to the Director**, this role owns end-to-end project planning, scheduling (using MS Project and Primavera P6), site coordination, vendor/contractor management, and timely project handover while ensuring strict adherence to quality, safety, and budget baselines.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Planning, Scheduling & Management Reporting (MSP & Primavera P6)

* Develop, baseline, and maintain detailed Master Construction Schedules, micro-schedules, and look-ahead plans using **MS Project (MSP)** and **Primavera P6**.
* Define Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), critical paths, dependencies, resource loading, and milestone trackers across civil, MEP, and fit-out phases.
* Conduct regular schedule variance analysis, identify delays early, and present recovery/catch-up plans and weekly executive MIS dashboards **to the Director**.

2. Site Execution & Multi-Disciplinary Coordination

* Lead end-to-end site execution for core civil works, MEP installations (HVAC, electrical, firefighting, plumbing, BMS), and interior fit-outs (partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery, finishes).
* Ensure seamless sequencing and clash resolution between civil, MEP, and interior finishing contractors to prevent rework and bottlenecks.
* Interpret architectural, structural, and MEP shop drawings, raising RFIs (Requests for Information) and coordinating design clarifications with consultants and clients.

3. Cost, BOQ & Contractor Management

* Review Bills of Quantities (BOQs), technical specifications, and vendor/contractor bids to ensure scope completeness, **submitting cost comparisons and recommendations to the Director for approval**.
* Track project budgets, validate contractor RA (Running Account) bills, monitor material reconciliation, and control extra items/variations.
* Drive subcontractor performance, enforce SLAs, and conduct weekly site progress reviews with documented Minutes of Meeting (MoMs).

4. Quality Assurance, EHS & Handover

* Implement Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) checklists, material inspections, and testing & commissioning protocols for MEP and fit-out systems.
* Enforce Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) compliance across all site teams and subcontractors.
* Manage snagging/de-snagging, as-built documentation, statutory approvals, and smooth client handover.

Qualifications & Skills Required

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering (PMP or NICMAR certification is an added advantage).
* **Experience:** 8–10 years in civil construction with proven execution experience in commercial/office interior fit-outs and MEP coordination.
* **Technical Tools:** Hands-on proficiency in **MS Project (MSP)**, **Primavera P6**, AutoCAD (drawing review), and MS Excel.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong command of construction sequencing, billing/BOQ verification, executive reporting, vendor negotiation, and site risk management.

Languages to be known:

Telugu,Hindi, English & Tamil

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
